confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from mixed Funchal sources: Numbeo-attributed aggregator figures, cost-of-living guides, and one Expatistan page. Dates range from 2024 to 2026, and the sources conflict somewhat. Meal and cappuccino anchors are medium confidence. The cocktail anchor is low-medium, since it rests on about 7 data points. The wine_glass anchor is low: no Funchal-specific wine-by-the-glass price was found, so it is set from the usual restaurant beer-to-wine relationship, with one wine-bar review as a cross-check. Euro amounts were converted at about 1.12 USD per EUR. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and July high-season context. They were not checked against live listings. One search returned hostel listings even though accommodation searches were not permitted; I treated those results only as loose context. The FX value is the most recent RBA figure I could retrieve, dated 2026-03-20. That is months before the generation date, so the latest RBA observation could not be confirmed and this rate may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Portuguese island tourist city. One aggregator source puts Funchal restaurant prices about 26% below Lisbon, so Funchal is treated as below mainland capital pricing. Food and drink anchors follow Funchal-specific aggregated figures. Wine and accommodation rely on regional Portugal and Madeira judgment.
